doc: docs/EMBEDDING.md §6: the files an embedder of the qed64 package needs. embed = the TypeScript closure of the `qed64/embed` entry (relative imports only); workers = plain scripts served at serveAs (lean.worker.js importScripts lsp-frames.js, memory64-probe.js and lsp-front-door.js from its own directory; the embed closure's src/runtime/client.ts also imports memory64-probe.js, for its side effect, the one source of the Memory64 probe bytes); pipeline = the from-source lane scripts and every Tier 1/2 CLI of docs/CLI-CONTRACT.md (relative and node: imports only, except preflight.mjs, whose boot smoke imports the caller's playwright when it runs); pipelineData = files the pipeline reads at run time, at the same relative paths; infra = the edge-worker library `qed64/edge` (one dependency-free ES module plus its types, docs/DEPLOY.md).

runtime.note: the oldest kernel patch level whose runtime these workers drive correctly (the resident header resolver and $/qed64/headerStatus, patch 0032), not what QED64 serves; compare against your release.json kernel.patch (lean4-wasm64 comparePatchIds ordering: NNNN, then an optional lowercase suffix)

workerProtocol.note: docs/EMBEDDING.md §7.7: the four worker scripts (lean.worker.js, lsp-frames.js, lsp-front-door.js, memory64-probe.js) carry `revision` and refuse a sibling of another one (WORKER_DEP_MISMATCH); `requests` is what capabilities().requests reports; a removal is listed under deprecated with the release it went unused in, and leaves the worker one release later
